Investigate the Alaris 8110 Syringe Module

Your assignment

Explore eight stations, distinguish mechanical and sensing faults, then complete twelve scenario-based questions. Retake missed questions until 100% mastery.

Learning outcomes: distinguish syringe retention, drive engagement, sensing and communication faults; select evidence-based diagnostics and repair-specific verifications.
